name: whetstone
description: A daily code-and-concept sharpening tool. Each morning generates one focused single-file lesson — concept in a comment block, failing test, your-code-here zone — in your primary language. Five to fifteen minutes per day. No stacking, no shaming, no perfectionism trap. Sibling to imprint (behavior) and ursula (voice); whetstone is the skill-and-knowledge layer.
